posts.title: A message from Fr. Ward
posts.author: Fr. Justin Ward
posts.preview: In this season of Easter, I wish to express my heartfelt gratitude to all who contributed to the great success of the Saint Mark Gala...
posts.body:
Dear Brothers and Sisters in Christ,

In this season of Easter, when the Church rejoices in the victory of the Risen Lord, I wish to express my heartfelt gratitude to all who contributed to the great success of the Saint Mark Gala on April 17. This event is a joyful and grace-filled evening, and I am deeply thankful for the many hands and generous hearts that made it possible.

In a special way, I extend my sincere thanks to our sponsors, whose generosity and support of our parish mission make this evening a success. I am equally grateful to all who worked tirelessly behind the scenes. Our Gala Committee planned, organized, and executed every detail with such care. I also thank those who attended and supported the event with their presence. Your participation is a powerful witness to the strength and unity of our parish community.

The Gala is not only a beautiful celebration but also a tremendous step forward in building momentum for our church beautification campaign, Echo of the Spirit. This effort seeks to bring to completion the original vision for our church, enhancing the sacred space in a way that reflects the glory of God and inspires all who enter. I am encouraged and uplifted by the enthusiasm and commitment that so many of you have shown toward this important endeavor.

As we continue in this sacred time between Easter and Pentecost, we are reminded that the joy of the Resurrection is not meant to be a fleeting moment, but a lasting transformation. The same spirit of renewal and hope that we celebrate at Easter is meant to carry us forward, energizing our mission and deepening our faith. May we continue to build upon the joy we have shared, trusting that the Lord who has begun this good work in us will bring it to fulfillment.

May the peace of the Risen Lord fill your hearts and homes, and may His grace guide you each day.

In Christ,
Fr. Justin Ward
